title: Park three data-protection items until real customer data exists?
bluf: The POC holds synthetic data only. Three items matter only if real data arrives: retention of client follow-up contact data (12 months proposed), tamper-evident audit storage on Azure SQL (today code rule plus DENY only), and a schema version bump that would change every ruleset hash. Recommend: defer all three, record the 12-month proposal, and revisit before any real data or the next ruleset re-issue. Default if you do not tap: option A, at 10:00 AEDT today (2026-11-10). Tickets: HPSMPOC-100, HPSMPOC-117, HPSMPOC-180
